description: Detective agent: the largest public-company holders of bitcoin or ether with values and share of supply, plus 1-day and 7-day stablecoin mint/redeem flows as a read on fresh capital. 0.005 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.
